title: Wingstop Manager Attacks Customer With Scalding Hot Oil During Heated Argument
description:
#police #news #crime 

On January 28th, 2025. Officers were called to a Wingstop regarding an employee who lost her temper and threw hot oil and ranch at a customer . This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
